title: What to Do After a Car Accident in Madison

sections.heading: First 10 minutes: safety and 911
paragraphs: A collision on Major highways and arterials in Madison or surface streets in Madison can escalate quickly. If vehicles are drivable and it is safe, move to a shoulder or parking lot. Turn on hazard lights.
Call 911 when anyone reports pain, airbags deploy, fluids leak, or traffic is blocked. Madison County / local jurisdiction dispatch will route Madison police or state patrol depending on location.
list: Stay inside the vehicle with seatbelts on if traffic passes closely at highway speed
Do not admit fault — describe facts only
Request a crash report number before officers leave

sections.heading: Madison documentation checklist
paragraphs: Photograph all vehicles, license plates, VIN stickers, skid marks, traffic signals, and visible injuries. Madison insurers expect timestamped photos.
Collect names and phone numbers from witnesses — independent accounts matter on Major highways and arterials in Madison and in Madison County / local jurisdiction.
Exchange insurance policy numbers and registration; note employer if the other driver was working.

sections.heading: Medical care within 24 hours
paragraphs: Madison has Madison area hospitals and emergency departments among its major facilities. Verify the nearest trauma center if injuries may be serious.
Whiplash, concussion, and internal injuries may appear hours later. A same-day urgent care or ER visit creates a medical record insurers cannot easily dismiss.

sections.heading: Alabama reporting rules
paragraphs: Alabama requires crash reporting when injuries, death, or significant property damage occur. Minimum liability limits are 25/50/25.
Cooperate with officers; request a copy of the report through the investigating agency. If police do not respond, check https://www.dot.state.al.us/ for self-report thresholds.

sections.heading: Insurance notification without hurting your claim
paragraphs: Notify your carrier with basic facts — date, location, vehicles involved. Decline recorded statements until you understand your coverage and injuries.
Alabama uses 51% bar comparative negligence; anything you say can affect fault allocation.

sections.heading: Evidence preservation in Madison
paragraphs: Dashcam, Ring doorbell, and business security footage near High-traffic corridors in Madison, AL is often deleted within 7–30 days. Send written preservation letters when appropriate.
Save repair estimates, rental receipts, and mileage to medical appointments.

paragraphs: Consider a free consultation if you were hospitalized, fault is disputed, a commercial vehicle was involved, or the adjuster offers a quick settlement before treatment finishes.
